newsitem.title: GERMANY: Merck forms joint venture with Biomet.
newsitem.headline: Merck forms joint venture with Biomet.

text.p: German drugs maker Merck KGaA said on Tuesday it had formed a joint venture to market orthopaedic drugs in Europe with drug producer Biomet Inc of the United States.
The 50-50 venture, called Biomet-Merck, was expected to have sales of about 300 million marks, Merck said in a statement.

Biomet, a leader in biotechnology with 1996 sales of 800 million marks, would bring its European operations into the joint venture and gain exclusive marketing rights for Merck's existing orthopaedic products outside of Europe.
The partnership exteneded Merck's offerings and gave it access to the U.S. market, the company said.
Merck had worldwide sales of 6.9 billion marks last year, as sales of products produced from biotechnology rose 10 percent to 114 million marks.
